correctness.rationale: Let c=2−2^(1/q)>0 for finite p≥1, with conjugate q and σ=1/(2−c)=2^(−1/q). The concrete B_c=min(u,v,max((u+v−c)/(2−c),0)) is a bivariate copula: for fixed u its conditional u derivative is nondecreasing as v increases, giving nonnegative rectangle volumes by integration, with correct margins. Its a.e. gradients (0,0),(1,0),(0,1),(σ,σ) all have dual ell_q norm≤1, as does M=min(u,v). Convex interpolations in disjoint ordinal-sum blocks and fixed top B_c block therefore form copulas globally one-Lipschitz in ell_p. At the strict middle-affine point of the fixed top block the gradient equals (σ,σ), whose dual ell_qprime norm exceeds 1 for every p′>p (also p′=infinity); every member has exact sharp p threshold, including p=1 and any finite p>1. The family parameterized by x∈[0,1]^N is affine, uniformly continuous in the product topology because the n-th block has height 2^(−n−1), hence compact and convex in sup norm. For x_n=t^n, a hypothetical finite linear relation vanishes at (1,1) and then yields ∑a_j t_j^n=0 on each nonanchor block; the first k such relations are an invertible Vandermonde system. Thus the compact convex set contains continuum many linearly independent members, maximal by cardinality of C([0,1]^2). Source check.py was inspected; its finite grids cannot establish the infinitely many p thresholds, which are separately proved.
